blockers.finding: The last successful operation validates only the output directory chain after the last final-file read/hash/name seal. A same-size final-file overwrite injected after that chain revalidation passed without any later file identity/content check, so _write_exclusive returned success with bytes different from the requested payload.
blockers.required_correction: Make a final joint publication seal whose ordering ends with the final file descriptor/content/name identity validation after the last directory-chain validation and after all fsync operations, with no subsequent filesystem-visible boundary before return. Add deterministic mutation after every directory-chain and final-file seal callback, including the current fifth chain check.

blockers.finding: Cleanup removes only symlinks or regular files matching the created inode. If the sealed temp name is replaced by an unrelated regular PASS immediately before renameat2, this implementation itself publishes the attacker inode to the final name, then correctly rejects it but refuses to unlink it. The failed call leaves an authorized lexical PASS. The same class applies to unrelated regular substitution of the final name after publication.
blockers.required_correction: Track successful publication and guarantee that any failure after this code creates or publishes the authorized final name removes that final name by no-follow unlink, regardless of substituted regular inode, while never following symlinks or deleting external hardlink targets. Revalidate final absence and fsync the authenticated parent before propagating failure. Add temp regular-file substitution immediately before rename, final regular-file substitution after rename, and failure/crash-boundary regressions that assert no authorized lexical PASS remains.

adjudication.reason: The ownership science, authenticated inputs and ordinary positive publication are correct, but the comparator can still return success with modified final bytes or fail while leaving an authorized lexical PASS artifact.
adjudication.required_next_step: Correct R3-B1 and R3-B2 without changing protected science or the frozen manifest, then obtain a fresh independent immutable-G0 PASS before preparing G1.
